visitor_job: Read KLCC’s actual nine statements of belief without distraction.

critical_answer: Preserve all nine clauses of the source creed. Paragraph boundaries and punctuation may be clarified without changing theological meaning.

objections_answered: Who is this for, when and where does it happen, and what happens after the action?
